questions.question: Where did warriors come to David while he was kept from Saul?
The men of Issachar were known for what?
options: Their great skill with the bow in the heat of fierce battle
Sailing the open seas and trading with far-off lands
Building strong walls and heavily fortified cities
Understanding the times and knowing what Israel should do
questions.answer: Understanding the times and knowing what Israel should do

questions.question: A great army came to Hebron to turn the kingdom of Saul over to David.

The Gadites had faces like _____ and were swift as gazelles on the mountains.
